_doc: Replacing rows of ml_tts_symbol.py (2026-10-18, set ttsSYM1r): one symbol class per sentence (phones, prices, decimals, big counts, Roman numerals) for the cells whose synthetic share is at its cap, so each new row can take the place of older single-class synthetic rows of the same class (supersedes) and the class sizes stay as they are. Slots as in carriers_sym.json.
